findings.description: F-003: the 'Рабочий пример — Scale' cell printed 'Толщина: 3' instead of 7, silently contradicting lesson 18.6's central claim that Scale's command receives the value. Root cause verified by experiment: the Scale is never .pack()ed and Tk does not invoke -command for a programmatic set on an unmapped widget.
findings.resolution: Fixed: added scale.pack() before scale.set(7) with an inline comment, plus a new 'Проверка результата' markdown+code cell asserting tolschina == 7. Re-executed via xvfb-run: rc=0, output now 'Толщина: 7' and 'Верно: ползунок передал значение 7 в переменную через command.'

findings.description: F-003: the notebook's «Scale» demo printed 3, contradicting its own lesson which teaches command= delivers the value.
findings.resolution: Added the missing scale.pack() before scale.set(7); command= only fires once the widget is actually mapped. Re-executed: output changed from 'Толщина: 3' to 'Толщина: 7'.
